200 when the service can serve traffic: it is not draining for shutdown, Postgres answers a ping and a
Kafka broker answers a metadata request (reachability only, never topics; the verdict is cached for a few
seconds). 503 with `{"status":"not_ready"}` while draining for shutdown; 503 `application/problem+json`
(`dependency-unavailable`, the detail names `postgres` and/or `kafka`) while a dependency is unreachable.
